scope: quality dimensions over PROFILED lakes (published /lakes/{k}/brain); coverage and validation fleet-wide

dimensions.label: Level source is the operator pool or the lake's own gauge
Operating guide or zone captured, where the operator publishes one
dimensions.fact: profiles[*].operatingPools.guideCurve.available or operatingZoneSource, over lakes with profiles[*].operatingPools.planPublication in {CAPTURED, PUBLISHED_NOT_CAPTURED}

publication.CAPTURED: strict guide curve, or a zone with BOTH a top and a bottom, documented
publication.PUBLISHED_NOT_CAPTURED: the operator publishes plan-type levels (a lower-pool level beside Top of Conservation; a TWDB conservation + dead pool pair) that do not meet the strict rule
publication.OPERATOR_READ_NO_PLAN: a verified operator project was read and publishes no plan-type level (not applicable)

dimensions.label: Last state is observed, not a proxy
Flood-pool state known, where a flood pool exists
dimensions.fact: states[*].floodPoolState != UNKNOWN, over lakes with profiles[*].operatingPools.floodPoolApplicability == EXISTS

applicability.EXISTS: an operator or TWDB flood-pool level is documented, OR the linked NID dam record lists 'Flood Risk Reduction' among its purposes
applicability.NOT_APPLICABLE: an NID dam record with purposes is linked, none of them is flood control, and no flood-pool level is documented
applicability.UNDETERMINED: no NID dam record or no purposes, and no flood-pool level is documented
applicability.EXISTS_but_unpublished: stays in the denominator as UNKNOWN: a pool that exists but whose level is not published is a real gap, not a non-applicability

dimensions.label: Claim validation (weakest published claim family)
dimensions.fact: min over COUNTED claim families of /validation/lake-brain/claims/{family}.status

families.claims: current pool elevation, operator guide / normal pool / flood-pool bottom as published, source id, freshness
difference from guide or normal pool, operator zone, 72 h mean rate, trend direction arithmetic
NORMAL / UNUSUAL / VERY_UNUSUAL against the lake's own history; trend label stability

dimensions.counted: a family counts while at least one of its claims is published; a family withheld from publication (status WITHHELD) is not counted and its claims are not shown

familyMaturity.PARTIAL: binding acceptance recorded (n >= 60, <= 1 error, flagged tier in full); plus per family: derivation = conformance fixtures and level-meaning review; historicalState = pre-registered hold-out PASS and ledger >= 90 days; rapidChange = a pre-registered criterion PASS on ledger data dated after its commit
familyMaturity.VALIDATED: PARTIAL plus per family: provider display and derivation = continuous freshness record >= 90 days; historicalState and rapidChange = >= 12 months of logged predictions scored once under the pre-registered criteria

gates.when: any COUNTED claim family is NOT_VALIDATED

movesUp: a validation run against operator truth
status: DRAFT PROPOSAL - NOT LOADED BY ANY SCORER - NOT ADOPTED (docs/brains/LAKE_BRAIN_RUBRIC_PROPOSALS.md)
